description: This Java class 'MathUtil' provides a collection of static utility methods for mathematical operations involving numeric types such as Long, BigDecimal, and domain-specific classes like Money and MonetaryCurrency. It includes null-safe conversions, comparisons, arithmetic operations, and formatting utilities, primarily used to support financial calculations in the FinFIC prototype project.

classes.name: MathUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for null-safe numerical and monetary calculations, comparisons, and formatting, used throughout the financial software project.

methods.name: nullToDefault
methods.description: Returns the value if not null; otherwise returns a default value.

methods.name: nullToZero
methods.description: Converts null to zero for Long, Integer, or BigDecimal types.

methods.name: zeroToNull
methods.description: Converts zero Long or Money instances to null.

methods.name: negativeToZero
methods.description: Converts negative Long or Money to zero.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Long, BigDecimal, or Money value is null or zero.

methods.name: isGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Checks if the Long, BigDecimal, or Money value is greater than zero.

methods.name: isLessThanZero
methods.description: Checks if the Long, BigDecimal, or Money value is less than zero.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the Long, BigDecimal, or Money value is zero.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Compares two Long, Integer, BigDecimal, or Money values for equality, considering nulls as zero when appropriate.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one Long or Money value is greater than another.

methods.name: isLessThan
methods.description: Checks if one Long or Money value is less than another.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two Long or multiple BigDecimal values considering nulls.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts Long or BigDecimal values, considering nulls.

methods.name: subtractToZero
methods.description: Subtracts multiple values, but results are constrained to zero or above.

methods.name: normalizeAmount
methods.description: Adjusts BigDecimal amounts to match the scale of the given currency.

methods.name: toMoney
methods.description: Converts BigDecimal amount to Money object with specified currency.

methods.name: toBigDecimal
methods.description: Extracts BigDecimal amount from Money object.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Negates BigDecimal or Money values in a null-safe manner.

methods.name: percentageOf
methods.description: Calculates a percentage of a BigDecimal value with specified precision or MathContext.

methods.name: stripTrailingZeros
methods.description: Removes insignificant trailing zeros from a BigDecimal.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum of two or more Money or BigDecimal values considering nulls and notNull flag.
